text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
When practice time came and she was nowhere to be seen,
I went looking for Hishi Amazon—

text_block_list.name: Miho Dorm Umamusume
text_block_list.text: A-Ane-san... that's probably enough for now...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
No way, call it a match and I can't back down.
One more round... I won't lose next time!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
"Isn't it obvious? It's Old Maid!
Dammit~ why can't I ever win at this...?"

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Huh? Why're you bringing up training right now—

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Wait, whoa, you've gotta be kidding me?!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Sorry, Trainy! I got so into it, it totally slipped my mind!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Seeing Hishi Amazon looking remorseful,
I firmly warned her to be more careful next time.
